units.speaker: Lallan
units.text: In Lallan's sweets, there is half sugar and half cheating!

units.speaker: Lallan
units.text: Arey! Who said that just now?

units.speaker: Lallan
units.text: But I... I was only thinking this in my head!

units.speaker: Chhotu
units.text: Chacha! Which new machine are you building today?

units.speaker: Jugaadu Chacha
units.text: This is... the 'Heart's Voice Radio'! Just point it at anyone, and you can hear their secret thoughts!

units.speaker: Jugaadu Chacha
units.text: But first, look at my brand new 'Talking Cooker'! It tells you exactly when the dal is ready.

units.speaker: Chhotu
units.text: Chacha, how does it talk like this?

units.speaker: Gudiya
units.text: <laugh> Chacha, your talking cooker gave us all a bath before saying anything!

units.speaker: Jugaadu Chacha
units.text: Hehe... its anger is a bit too much, yaar. Come on, look at the real machine!

units.speaker: Gudiya
units.text: Heart's voice? Chacha, the heart only goes dhak-dhak, it doesn't really talk!

units.speaker: Jugaadu Chacha
units.text: It does, beta. It's just that nobody listens.

units.speaker: Jugaadu Chacha
units.text: Look! Our very first test — Sheru!

units.speaker: Sheru
units.text: I also want sweet laddus! Not just one, but two!

units.speaker: Chhotu
units.text: Hahaha! Chacha, this really and truly works!

units.speaker: Jugaadu Chacha
units.text: But listen, it is not completely ready yet. So nobody should take it outside!

units.speaker: Chhotu
units.text: Absolutely not, Chacha!

units.speaker: Gudiya
units.text: Just for a tiny little bit...

units.speaker: Chhotu
units.text: It will be so much fun at the fair!

units.speaker: Raju
units.text: Look at my amazing kite! It will fly highest in the whole village!

units.speaker: Chhotu
units.text: Really? Oh radio, let us hear what is inside Raju's heart!

units.speaker: Raju
units.text: Gudiya flies kites much better than me... but I will never, ever admit this!

units.speaker: Gudiya
units.text: Yes! Did you all hear?

units.speaker: Raju
units.text: Arey! This... this machine is a big liar!

units.speaker: Pandit
units.text: The cashews are too less in the prasad... Oh my God, I hope nobody finds out!

units.speaker: Gudiya
units.text: Even Pandit ji!

units.speaker: Lallan
units.text: Not even one balloon has sold since morning... what will I take back home today?

units.speaker: Chhotu
units.text: The balloon-wala bhaiya is so sad...

units.speaker: Gudiya
units.text: Come on, let us buy one balloon each with our own pocket money!

units.speaker: Masterji
units.text: Children, come to school on time tomorrow. Discipline is extremely important.

units.speaker: Masterji
units.text: I wish tomorrow was a holiday as well... so I could sleep all day long.

units.speaker: Masterji
units.text: Whose... whose voice is that coming from?

units.speaker: Lallan
units.text: There they are! They are holding some kind of magic box in their hand!

units.speaker: Gudiya
units.text: Let's run!

units.speaker: Jugaadu Chacha
units.text: Stop! That machine is not fully ready yet!

units.speaker: Sheru
units.text: A race! I really, really love to race!

units.speaker: Chhotu
units.text: Sheru, please not right now!

units.speaker: Chhotu
units.text: We are safe!

units.speaker: Gudiya
units.text: Did you see the funny look on Lallan Chacha's face?

units.speaker: Dadi
units.text: Everyone has grown up so much... now nobody comes to hear my stories.

units.speaker: Dadi
units.text: Today also I made sweet laddus for the children... but nobody came at all.

units.speaker: Gudiya
units.text: Dadi... is sitting all by herself.

units.speaker: Chhotu
units.text: Dadi had called me in the morning... and I just said, 'Later, Dadi.'

units.speaker: Lallan
units.text: We were all busy at the fair... and Dadi was here all alone.

units.speaker: Masterji
units.text: The radio was absolutely right.

units.speaker: Jugaadu Chacha
units.text: Some things are not heard on a radio... but by sitting close to each other.

units.speaker: Chhotu
units.text: Dadi! Look, we have brought the entire fair to you!

units.speaker: Dadi
units.text: Arey! All of you came here? Leaving the fair?

units.speaker: Chhotu
units.text: I am sorry, Dadi. You called me in the morning and I did not come.

units.speaker: Dadi
units.text: Arey, my silly boy... you came, that is enough.

units.speaker: Gudiya
units.text: Dadi, please tell us a story now!

units.speaker: Dadi
units.text: So listen... the story of my first Diwali. Back then, there was no electricity in our village...

units.speaker: Dadi
units.text: On that night, only diyas were burning in the whole village. My own grandmother would make all of us kids sit close to her...

units.speaker: Dadi
units.text: ...and she would say — a diya only burns when it is filled with the oil of love.

units.speaker: Lallan
units.text: And please have this, Dadi — my special sweets. Today they have full sugar in them!

units.speaker: Chhotu
units.text: Hahaha!

units.speaker: Dadi
units.text: Children, Diwali is not lit up just by diyas... but by sitting together with your loved ones.

units.speaker: Gudiya
units.text: Masterji, no notebooks today — today is Diwali!

units.speaker: Masterji
units.text: Arey... a diya for me? After so many years, someone...

units.speaker: Chhotu
units.text: And a holiday tomorrow? <short pause> The radio told us so!

units.speaker: Masterji
units.text: Hahaha! Okay, okay... half-day holiday tomorrow!

units.speaker: Chhotu
units.text: Chacha, we are sorry... we took your machine without asking you first.

units.speaker: Jugaadu Chacha
units.text: I was not worried about the radio, beta... on Diwali, even I was feeling so alone.

units.speaker: Gudiya
units.text: Not anymore! Come along, Dadi is telling a story now!

units.speaker: Jugaadu Chacha
units.text: Really? Let's go, let's go! But first... ja-le-bis!

units.speaker: Sheru
units.text: Will I get my sweet laddu now?

units.speaker: Jugaadu Chacha
units.text: Hahaha! You will surely get one for this!
